conoha.vps.additional_ssd.note: Additional SSD (追加SSD) by size in GB, hourly billing up to the monthly amount. Tax-inclusive yen as published. Read on the pricing page; ConoHa publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

conoha.vps.boot_storage.note: Boot storage added (ブートストレージ容量追加) above the 100 GB a plan includes, by the GB added; API and hourly billing only, not on the 512 MB plan. Tax-inclusive yen as published. Read on the pricing page; ConoHa publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it
